title: A transfer mandate, from approval to revocation.
help: This walkthrough runs the local app and records its observed results. Recording is limited to the demonstration canvas. MDT is a synthetic token with no monetary value.
recording: Recording the simulation walkthrough. The result will be saved in this demo's data directory.
saved: Recording saved. The observed workflow matched every expected result.
failed: The recording stopped because a required result could not be verified.
unsupported: This browser does not support canvas recording in WebM format.
footer: Observed local app results. No blockchain transaction is broadcast.

steps.title: An agent requests. The owner decides.
steps.body: The agent can prepare a transfer. Approval belongs to the owner workspace.
steps.detail: The same checks serve the browser and the scoped MCP tools.

steps.title: The owner sets a bounded mandate.
steps.body: 60 MDT per transfer. 100 MDT in total. Only listed recipients are allowed.
steps.detail: Creating a mandate preserves previous activity and demo balances.

steps.title: Review the request before approval.
steps.body: 30 MDT passes the local checks. The owner reviews the recipient and the complete plan hash.
steps.detail: A changed plan cannot reuse the original approval.

steps.title: One approved transfer is simulated.
steps.body: The app rechecks the approval and current mandate before applying 30 MDT to the ledger.
steps.detail: The receipt records the observed balances before and after.

steps.title: A retry returns the same receipt.
steps.body: The same request ID and plan hash return the existing result. The balance stays unchanged.
steps.detail: An ID reused for a different request is rejected.

steps.title: 80 MDT is denied locally.
steps.body: The request exceeds the limit of 60 MDT per transfer. No approval or balance change follows.

steps.title: The remaining budget is checked too.
steps.body: 50 MDT succeeds. A following request for 25 MDT exceeds the 20 MDT remaining.
steps.detail: Two accepted transfers have now used 80 MDT in total.

steps.title: Revocation blocks the next request.
steps.body: The owner revokes the mandate once. A request for 1 MDT is then denied.
steps.detail: Enforcing layer: local mandate state. There is no failed chain transaction.

steps.title: The Sepolia path has its own boundary.
steps.body: Unsigned preparation is separate from this ledger. A live run needs fresh checks and an authorized signer.
steps.detail: The package includes exact transaction validation, recovery and semantic postcheck code with fixture tests.
